statBlock.name: Dust Mephit
statBlock.description: An elemental of earth and air drawn to tombs by its fascination with death.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, dust bursts out in a 5-ft. radius around it. Each creature in that radius makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. It may repeat the save on each of its turns and ends the blindness on a success.
Elemental Nature. The mephit can go without food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma. Once per day, the mephit can cast Sleep without material components.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Blinding Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone of dust makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the blindness on a success.

statBlock.name: Dust Mephit (Summoner Variant)
statBlock.description: An elemental of earth and air drawn to tombs by its fascination with death.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, dust bursts out in a 5-ft. radius around it. Each creature in that radius makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. It may repeat the save on each of its turns and ends the blindness on a success.
Elemental Nature. The mephit can go without food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma. Once per day, the mephit can cast Sleep without material components.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Blinding Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone of dust makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the blindness on a success.
Summon Mephits (1/day). The mephit has a 25 percent chance to summon 1d4 dust mephits. Each appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner and fights on its side. A summoned mephit cannot summon others. It vanishes after 1 minute, when either it or the summoner dies, or when the summoner spends an action to dismiss it.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 215. Mephit Summoning variant, p. 217.

statBlock.name: Ice Mephit
statBlock.description: A merciless elemental of frigid air and water that hides among shards of ice.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 10 Dexterity save against flying ice shards. The burst deals 4 (1d8) slashing damage on a failure or half damage on a success.
False Appearance. A motionless mephit looks exactly like an ordinary shard of ice.
Elemental Nature. The mephit can go without food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma. Once per day, the mephit can cast Fog Cloud without material components.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.
Frost Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. The breath deals 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

statBlock.name: Steam Mephit
